versions.subject: Add proc_creation_win_icacls_deny
versions.detection:
selection_icacls:
    - OriginalFileName: iCACLS.EXE
    - Image|endswith: '\icacls.exe'
selection_cmd: #icacls "C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\37f92fe8-bcf0-4ee0-b8ba-561f797f5696" /deny *S-1-1-0:(OI)(CI)(DE,DC)
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'C:\Users\'
        - '/deny'
        - '*S-1-1-0:'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="iCACLS.EXE" OR Image="*\\icacls.exe" CommandLine="*C:\\Users\\*" CommandLine="*/deny*" CommandLine="*S-1-1-0:*"
